summary: Rapid elevation of 5xx from api-gateway after autoscaler backfill causing runtime restart chain
description: Issue summary: Between 2026-03-13 02:10-02:35 UTC we observed a sharp increase in 5xx responses for requests from Lexicon Health. Errors reported were primarily 502/503/504 from the API gateway with correlated upstream runtime processes terminating (SIGKILL) during an autoscaler 'backfill' operation.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate sustained tenant traffic ramp (10k rps burst) with streaming sessions enabled
2) Trigger a scheduled autoscaler backfill (scale-up of reserved ephemeral workers) while some runtime nodes are performing kernel hotpatch and model prefetch
3) Observe API gateway error rate and runtime healthchecks over a 5–30 minute window
logs: apigw: 2026-03-13T02:12:06Z ERR upstream_reset code=502 reason=upstream-reset-by-peer route=lexicon-health streaming=true
runtime: 2026-03-13T02:12:12Z INFO watchdog: received SIGKILL from cgroup (oom kill?) pid=23481 model=rwdl/opt-14b-v1
autoscaler: 2026-03-13T02:11:58Z INFO backfill:start pool=ephemeral size_target=12 reason=scheduled_backfill
kernel: 2026-03-13T02:12:08Z WARN nvdriver: gpu-reset detected on node gpu-74; subsequent process exits observed
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: backfill caused a resource pressure pattern (ephemeral worker creation + simultaneous model prefetch) that overlapped with a kernel-level GPU reset on a subset of nodes, leading to runtime exit loops and cascading 5xx at the gateway.
Evidence: runtime logs show SIGKILLs and repeated model load attempts; kernel logs show gpu-reset on node set; api-gateway logs show upstream reset followed by conn-close and retry amplification.

Observed amplification vector: long-lived streaming sessions held keepalives to restarted runtimes; retries from the gateway and client SDK produced backpressure spikes leading to more worker creation and further contention.
SRE reproduced locally by replaying tenant traffic plus simultaneous backfill — seen similar pattern: prefetch hotpaths + kernel reset => repeated runtime restarts within 30s window.

Temporary mitigation applied: paused scheduled backfill job for affected pool and activated an emergency route-level rate-shed for Lexicon Health's streaming routes to reduce retry amplification. Notified customer of mitigation steps.
comments: Support (Maya Patel) 2026-03-13T02:30Z: Customer reported increased 5xx and dropped streaming sessions; provided initial request ids and sample timestamps.
SRE (Jonah Reed) 2026-03-13T03:05Z: Running live instrumentation to correlate runtime exits with GPU resets; requested permission to pause autoscaler backfill for pool 'ephemeral'.

Customer (Lexicon Health - Sarah Kim) 2026-03-13T03:20Z: Confirmed we are seeing elevated 502s for inference and streaming interruptions in production, asking for ETA for recovery as this affects clinical note workflows.
SRE (Jonah Reed) 2026-03-13T03:40Z: Paused backfill and applied temporary per-tenant rate-shed for streaming (50% reduction). Error rate dropped ~70% in 10 minutes. Collecting logs for postmortem.
